about:
Commercial Apparel, Inc. was founded in 1977 in Winfield, Missouri, initially as a manufacturer of baseball caps. The company is now owned by PicTheGift, a partnership that has expanded its service offerings into advanced printing technology.

Today the firm operates as a full-service contract sewing and printing operation. Its capabilities include precision laser cutting, wide-format dye-sublimation printing up to 74 inches wide, and a range of sewing services such as elastic incorporating, cover stitch, single stitch, surge, backstitch, and buttonhole work. The product line focuses on customizable cut-and-sew items including baby crib sheets, changing pad covers, and pajama pants.

The company serves businesses seeking end-to-end textile production, from prototype to finished goods, with no order minimums and no setup charges. Its customer base spans apparel brands, promotional product distributors, and juvenile product manufacturers who require quick turnaround on custom fabric goods.

Commercial Apparel emphasizes its integrated sewing and printing workflow as a key differentiator, allowing vivid, long-lasting designs at competitive pricing. The ownership transition to PicTheGift brought sublimation technology in-house, enabling the firm to control both fabrication and decoration under one roof.
